You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To take a shower before work, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Check if the water heater is turned on (10 seconds)
Step 2. Step into the bathtub (5 seconds)
Step 3. Locate the bottle of shampoo (15 seconds)
Step 4. Begin rinsing hair (1 minute)
Step 5. Pick up the loofah (5 seconds)
Step 6. Adjust the shower head angle (10 seconds)
Step 7. Scrub the back of the neck (30 seconds)
Step 8. Check the water temperature with a hand (5 seconds)
Step 9. Apply face wash (45 seconds)
Step 10. Turn on the bathroom exhaust fan (5 seconds)
Step 11. Grab a clean washcloth (20 seconds)
Step 12. Wash underarms (40 seconds)
Step 13. Find the body scrub (15 seconds)
Step 14. Rinse off all soap suds (2 minutes)
Step 15. Wet the loofah thoroughly (10 seconds)
Step 16. Remove pajamas (30 seconds)
Step 17. Squeeze out some conditioner (10 seconds)
Step 18. Reach for the soap bar (5 seconds)
Step 19. Set the water mixer to the perfect heat (20 seconds)
Step 20. Walk into the bathroom (10 seconds)
Step 21. Pull the shower curtain closed (5 seconds)
Step 22. Scrub the left leg (30 seconds)
Step 23. Test the spray pressure (10 seconds)
Step 24. Open the bottle of body wash (5 seconds)
Step 25. Lay down the bath mat (10 seconds)
Step 26. Apply conditioner to hair ends (1 minute)
Step 27. Squeeze shampoo into palm (10 seconds)
Step 28. Wash the chest and torso (45 seconds)
Step 29. Rinse the face (20 seconds)
Step 30. Set out a fresh towel (15 seconds)
Step 31. Unlock the shower door (5 seconds)
Step 32. Place the dirty clothes in the hamper (30 seconds)
Step 33. Clear the steam from the mirror (15 seconds)
Step 34. Rinse the body one last time (1 minute)
Step 35. Apply body wash to the cloth (15 seconds)
Step 36. Use the body scrub on elbows (40 seconds)
Step 37. Wash the feet (50 seconds)
Step 38. Enter the master bedroom (20 seconds)
Step 39. Turn the shower handle to 'on' (5 seconds)
Step 40. Wait for the water to run clear (15 seconds)
Step 41. Lather the loofah (20 seconds)
Step 42. Pour shampoo onto the head (10 seconds)
Step 43. Adjust the drain stopper (5 seconds)
Step 44. Scrub the right arm (30 seconds)
Step 45. Put on a shower cap if not washing hair (10 seconds)
Step 46. Rinse the soap off the torso (30 seconds)
Step 47. Remove jewelry (45 seconds)
Step 48. Hang the bathrobe on the hook (15 seconds)
Step 49. Check the bathroom clock (5 seconds)
Step 50. Dry the face with a small towel (30 seconds)
